title: Containerization, Cloud Platforms & CI/CD for AI
subtitle: Package, deploy, and automate AI workloads with Docker, Kubernetes, cloud, and CI/CD
description: This second-semester deployment course picks up where the applied lab leaves off. Students move from local Docker basics into production-minded container images, Compose, registries, image scanning, Kubernetes fundamentals, cloud platforms, infrastructure as code, and CI/CD pipelines for AI workloads. GPU-aware Kubernetes and advanced serving are introduced as deployment context, while deep production inference tuning remains in AIINFRA 201.
objectives: Build, tag, scan, and publish container images for AI/Python services using Docker and a container registry.
Run multi-container AI stacks locally and explain when to move from Compose to Kubernetes or managed cloud services.
Deploy containerized AI workloads using Kubernetes fundamentals, cloud compute, object storage, and managed AI/ML services.
Build CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions that test, scan, build, and deploy containerized model services automatically.
Apply infrastructure-as-code, IAM, secrets controls, budget guardrails, and monitoring to cloud AI deployments.
slos: Build, tag, scan, and publish container images for AI/Python services.
Run multi-container AI stacks locally and explain the bridge from Compose to Kubernetes or managed cloud services.
Deploy containerized AI workloads using Kubernetes fundamentals, cloud compute, object storage, and managed AI/ML services.
Create GitHub Actions pipelines that test, scan, build, and deploy containerized model services.
Apply infrastructure-as-code, IAM, secrets controls, budget guardrails, and monitoring to cloud AI deployments.

weeks.title: From Local Lab to Deployable AI Service
weeks.summary: Reviews AIINFRA 102 lab evidence and frames the second-semester move from local service to deployable artifact.

weeks.title: Production Dockerfiles, Layers, and Build Caching
weeks.summary: Builds secure, repeatable Docker images for AI/Python services and explains image-layer caching.

weeks.title: Docker Compose for Multi-Service AI Applications
weeks.summary: Uses Compose to run app, model, database/cache, and monitoring sidecars in a local stack.

weeks.title: Registries, Tags, SBOMs, and Image Scanning
weeks.summary: Covers registry workflows, semantic tags, SBOM basics, and Trivy-style image scanning/remediation.

weeks.title: Kubernetes Fundamentals: Pods, Deployments, Services, and Config
weeks.summary: Introduces core Kubernetes objects and the deployment model used by AI services.

weeks.title: Deploying a Containerized AI Service to Kubernetes
weeks.summary: Deploys a small AI inference service with manifests, resource requests, health checks, and service exposure.

weeks.title: Cloud Computing for AI: Providers, Regions, and Free Tiers
weeks.summary: Introduces AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud free-tier structures and the distinction between regions and zones.

weeks.title: Cloud Accounts, IAM, Networking, and Cost Guardrails
weeks.summary: Midterm week: covers least-privilege IAM, networking basics, secrets, and budget controls for student-safe cloud labs.

weeks.title: Cloud Compute, Object Storage, and Managed AI/ML Services
weeks.summary: Compares cloud VMs, object storage, and managed AI/ML services for deployment and experimentation.

weeks.title: Infrastructure as Code for AI Deployments with Terraform
weeks.summary: Teaches Terraform workflow, state, variables, and provisioning a small no-cost or low-cost AI deployment.

weeks.title: Introduction to CI/CD and GitHub Actions
weeks.summary: Introduces CI/CD concepts and builds a first GitHub Actions workflow for an AI service repository.

weeks.title: Continuous Integration: Tests, Scans, and Image Builds
weeks.summary: Extends CI with tests, dependency checks, image scanning, and reproducible container image builds.

weeks.title: Continuous Delivery: Automated Deployment and Rollback
weeks.summary: Covers deployment automation, blue-green/canary concepts, and rollback plans for model services.

weeks.title: Monitoring, Logging, and Cost Optimization for Cloud AI
weeks.summary: Covers logs, metrics, alerts, and cost optimization for deployed AI workloads.

weeks.title: GPU-Aware Orchestration Preview and Handoff to AIINFRA 201
weeks.summary: Previews GPU Operator, managed Kubernetes, KServe, and the deeper production-serving work in AIINFRA 201.

weeks.title: Capstone Project & Course Review
weeks.summary: Students deliver a containerized, scanned, CI/CD-backed AI deployment with cloud or local fallback evidence.
